The '''''Rockhound''''' was a [[BramDorc Corporation]] [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug]] owned by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].

==History==
There was record of its existence from as far back as [[524 BBY]]. Calrissian won the ship from a [[Brubb]] prospector in a six-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] arm wrestling match. The ''Rockhound'' was maintained by an all-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] crew. In [[44 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] contacted Calrissian to request help in naviagting [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] for his upcoming [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] with his [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith allies]], and Calrissian agreed. He spent the next two weeks renovating and updating the ''Rockhound'', before traveling to [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] and then meeting up with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] just outside the Maw. The ''Rockhound'' used its [[Asteroid tug tractor beam|tractor beams]] to protect the small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of ships. They arrived at their first stop in the Maw, [[Sinkhole Station]], only to find that it had been destroyed. Two of the Sith [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] flew into the debris field, and the ''Rockhound'' attempted to pull them back, successfully stopping one. The other frigate, however, was going too fast, and was obliterated when it crashed into the debris. After completing the mission, Skywalker sent the ''Rockhound'', with Calrissian and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] aboard, to report back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], however it had been infiltrated by a droid with an impostor protocol, which gave out false orders to the other droids aboard the ship in Calrissian's voice.
